headline: Discussed the 5th Annual Senior Expo, CART ride hours, and Jim Green Award application; agreed to skip December meeting.
summary: Members praised the 5th Annual Senior Expo, which had over 400 participants, and want a subcommittee to vet vendors next year. Meridel Allen resigned from the committee, and a CART representative may be invited to a future meeting to explain service hours.
decisions: Agreed to skip the December meeting and start again in January.
Postponed discussion of the 5th Annual Senior Expo until more committee members are present.

decision_evidence.quote: The committee agreed to skip the busy holiday season and start strong in January.
Overall, we will save discussion on the expo until more committee members are present.
